doc.title: Arturo O'Farrill interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 6, 2024

chapter: Rhythm and the African roots of jazz
title: Girl from Ipanema and Latin music misconceptions
summary: Monk Rowe says musicians used to answer Latin requests with Girl from Ipanema; mention of Victor Rendon and Bronx Conexion.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: What we played: tunes and repertoire in the early days

blocks.x: When musicians like myself, my generation, for years dancers would come up and play something Latin and invariably we would think that we were doing the right thing by playing the “Girl from Ipanema.”
And it’s just stunning. I’ve learned some — we’ve had some guests here over the years, Victor Rendon and others —
I know Victor, sure. Bronx Conexion.
